Maya R: heads up — hit a mypy/pyright failure in the python sampleapp when using autogen models + async client. repro below, cc @Luis G

Luis G: can you paste the minimal repro and the exact error?

Maya R: sure. steps: clone sampleapp, pip install -e ., run `mypy --strict` on `examples/async_sample.py`. error is about assignment/incompatible types. snippet of the generated model (runtime):
```py
# runtime autogen (pydantic)
class Message(BaseModel):
    tags: list[str] | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
```
stub produced by our generator (.pyi):
```py
class Message(BaseModel):
    tags: list[str]
    metadata: dict[str, Any]
```
The mismatch (tags Optional at runtime, non-Optional in stub) makes mypy/pyright complain in strict mode: `Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type "List[str] | None", variable has type "list[str]")`

Alex P: ouch. sounds like the stub generator dropped optionals when default is None or default_factory. Is this only for lists or for all optionals?

Maya R: happens for list/tuple/set and anything with `= None` default. default_factory fields are getting flattened too — metadata loses the Field(default_factory=...) semantics in the pyi and becomes non-optional.

Erica S: I think this is because our pydantic->stub mapping tries to infer a concrete type when it sees a default, but it doesn't carry over `Optional[...]` if default is None. Quick fix: when default is None OR default_factory is used, mark the stub type as `Optional[...]` or `X | None`.

Luis G: agreed. we should be conservative and generate Optional for any field where the runtime default is None OR Field(default_factory=...). Also add a test that runs mypy/pyright strict on the sampleapp. PR idea: auto-detect default and set `Optional[T]` in stub.

Maya R: also another related thing: async client method return types — runtime yields an `AsyncIterator[Message]` but our stubs emitted `Iterator[Message]`. pyright flags this as: `AsyncIterator is not compatible with Iterator` when using strict async checks.

Alex P: ugh. that explains why the streaming sampleapp typed weirdly. Two separate codegen bugs: (1) optional/default handling, (2) sync vs async iterator return typing.

Erica S: quick workaround for teams: add `# type: ignore[assignment]` on the client call site or loosen mypy settings, but we should fix generator.

Luis G: opened draft PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/1234 with initial tests + failing CI. the branch updates the stub template to use `Optional[...]` when default is None and swaps `Iterator` -> `AsyncIterator` for async defs. please review.

CI Bot: ci/circle — tests failed on pyright-strict (see https://ci.internal/1234) :x:

Alex P: I can take a stab at the stub template. small patch: when emitting field type, do `t = maybe_optional(t, has_default_or_factory)` and ensure we `from typing import Optional, AsyncIterator` when needed.

Erica S: also add a test that runs both mypy and pyright (we've had drift between them). replicate with `python -m pip install -r dev-requirements.txt` then `tox -e lint-types` in CI.

Maya R: i'll add a minimal `examples/repros/typing_repro.py` that demonstrates both issues (field None default + async stream mismatch). will push in a minute. thanks all :raised_hands:

Luis G: once PR is green we should backport to the generator in `tools/autogen` — lots of customers import the pyi from the hosted SDKs and this causes real onboarding pain.

Alex P: agreed. i'll open a follow-up against `tools/autogen` with the same logic and include a changelog entry `Fix: ensure Optional in stubs for None/default_factory and AsyncIterator for async streaming APIs`.

Maya R: thanks everyone. happy to help validate. i'll try the PR and report back.

Erica S: leaving a note for the SDK team: if anyone hits this in the field, ask them to run `pip install redwood-sdk==dev --pre` from the branch or use the wheel from the PR artifacts so they get the fixed pyi until we release.

Luis G: follow-up task: add an integration job that runs both typecheckers on the sampleapp on every autogen change. creating task in #eng-devex.

Maya R: posted repro and screenshot in the PR. thanks again! :heart:
